subject: Post-discovery: propose tech deep-dive windows + attendee list
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: propose tech deep-dive windows + attendee list

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep-dive with your engineering team: 

1) Quick recap from our discovery call:
- Primary goal: evaluate runtime performance and data controls for patient PII workflows.
- Success criteria: <100ms median latency for short prompts, private VPC option, SOC2 evidence for procurement.

2) Proposed technical deep-dive (60–75 mins) agenda (high level):
- 10m intro & roles
- 25m architecture & integration patterns (Marcus)
- 20m demo of inference flow + KV caching behavior
- 15m Q&A + next steps

3) Availability windows (PT):
- Wed May 19 — 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Thu May 20 — 1:00–2:15 PM PT
If neither works, send 2x preferred times and I will coordinate.

4) Please confirm attendee list (we normally want: eng lead, platform/infra, security/ops).

I attached our quick discovery notes for internal reference. Once you confirm a slot I will send a calendar invite with the Zoom bridge and an agenda doc.

Thanks — look forward to continuing.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachment: discovery-notes-ellipsis.pdf (summary of this call)

Thanks Stephanie — great recap. Wed the 19th at 10am PT works best for our eng lead and Liam is joining. Security will likely join from Ellipsis as well: I expect Asha Narang (security ops) to attend.

Two quick asks before the deep-dive: 
- Can you share a short agenda doc we can distribute internally?
- Our procurement team will request SOC2 evidence; can you point me to the relevant artifact (or the right person to send it to)?

If anything changes I will flag it ASAP. Otherwise please send the invite and Zoom link.

Best,
